description: Rust-red long tailored overdress with low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves, narrow multicoloured woven trim at neckline, bodice seams, cuffs and front opening; cream underdress visible down the lower central opening. A cream shawl with restrained patterned ends rests around the elbows and arms. Dark leather belt with round metal buckle and small fittings, brown leather shoes. Both hands clasped in front. No headgear, armor or weapon; trim more ornate than minimal landowner clothing.
